deployment_contract: first n_visible true frames plus static medium/source and solve-free warp anchor; metrics use frames >= n_visible
selection_rule: per family: completed qc-pass train records grouped by group_id; sample unique groups without replacement, then one record per group
window_rule: train-truth-only diagnostic selection: first frame with RMS >= onset_rms_fraction*max frame RMS, clamped to time_count-k_frames
